- **G:** The doc bakes in a compat-alias migration, violating your standing "no compat aliases — ever" rule — plus an internal contradiction (`nmp.wallet.pay_invoice` listed as both canonical *and* an alias). (Fable caught this one.)
- **B:** It silently reassigns `WalletPaymentPort` ownership away from `nmp-nip47`, contradicting crate-boundaries §8 — two durable docs now disagree.
- **D:** Ownership model omits the real `nmp-nwc` codec crate.
- **C / H / E:** New `nmp-wallet` L4 crate should cite the `nmp-note-feed` precedent to avoid reading as a forbidden "bucket"; justify/drop the `nmp-nip57` dep; fix "composition owner" vs "composition root" terminology.
